ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black surface with high-contrast localized white pixel clusters; approximate area ratio of 1:8 white-to-black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-pigmented surface. Discrete circular high-intensity white blobs distributed across the lower-medial and distal regions of both lobes. Significant white mottling/patching localized on the distal-lateral tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle and a depth approximately 1/10th of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular continuous boundary. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits small-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular jagged excavations and large non-uniform peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit convex curvature sweeping symmetrically upward and outward from the peduncle center.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups located at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular constellations across the ventral surface of the left lobe and mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned short linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss/jagged profile on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Large, high-relief calcified biological clusters (barnacles) localized on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in trailing edge topography between the left and right lobes.
